### Observed differences

- In the later window, A01 appears in about 53 in 100 traces (about 106 of 200) versus about 28 in 100 (about 55 of 200) earlier, and its mean occurrences per trace roughly doubled from about 0.53 to 1.10. [OCC001]
- A01's successors changed completely: earlier, about 94 in 100 of its observed outgoing transitions went to A07 (small shares to A03 and A04); in the later window A07 is no longer observed as a target — A05 receives about 57 in 100, A06 about 18, A04 about 14 and A03 about 11. [DIR001]
- A05 and A07 effectively exchanged places along the loop: A05 now leads to A07 in about 91 in 100 transitions (earlier it led to A01 in about 96 in 100), and A07 now leads to A01 in about 94 in 100 (earlier about 43 to A05 and 41 to A06). Immediate successions mirror this: A01→A07 and A05→A01 at distance 1 disappeared, while A01→A05, A05→A07 and A07→A01 at distance 1 appeared. [DIR004, DIR006, LAG003, LAG009, LAG001, LAG011, LAG012]
- A07 became less frequent and repeats less: it appears in about 29 in 100 later traces (about 58 of 200) versus about 51 in 100 before, with mean occurrences per trace falling from about 1.03 to 0.57. [OCC002]
- A06 moved from the end towards the middle of the trace (mean position about 0.96 to about 0.48 of the trace length; median from the final position to about 0.44) at similar participation (about 51 vs 53 in 100 traces). Earlier, A07 preceded A06 in about 23 in 100 traces, usually immediately; in the later window the two rarely co-occur (about 29 in 100), A06 appears without A07 in about 24 in 100, and it now leads mostly to A01, A03 and A05. [POS003, REL009, DIR005]
- A03 and A04 became tied to A01: earlier each appeared without A01 in about 23 in 100 traces, whereas in the later window they co-occur with A01 in about 53 in 100 and never without it. Their outgoing transitions shifted from mostly A07 (about 51 and 41 in 100) towards A01 and A06, and A03/A04 are now followed by A01 within one to two steps instead of leading back to A07. [REL001, REL002, DIR002, DIR003, LAG004, LAG006, LAG005, LAG008]
- Secondary shifts: A05 and A07 now occur somewhat later in the trace (mean positions about 0.47 → 0.57 and 0.51 → 0.69), and A01's occurrences are more spread across the trace. [POS002, POS004, POS001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the control flow around the A01–A05–A07 loop was reordered: the earlier cycle A01 → A07 → A05 → back to A01 appears to run as A01 → A05 → A07 → back to A01 in the later window, with A05 and A07 exchanging places, while the side branch through A06 (earlier A07 → A06 → A03/A04 → back to A07 near the trace end) now feeds into A01 and A05 earlier in the trace, with A03 and A04 leading to A01/A06 instead of returning to A07. Participation shifted accordingly: A01 now runs in about half of the traces, A07 in about three in ten and repeats less. [DIR001, DIR004, DIR006, LAG001, LAG003, LAG009, LAG011, LAG012, POS003, REL009, DIR002, DIR003, OCC001, OCC002]

The reordering is shown directly rather than inferred from frequencies alone: successor profiles changed at A01, A05 and A07, immediate successions appeared and disappeared exactly where the reordering predicts, and the co-occurrence and position evidence agrees. The volume of qualifying items (35 control-flow items against roughly 0.29 expected for an unchanged process, each difference larger than about 995 in 1,000 random re-splits) far exceeds what a stable process produces. [DIR001, DIR004, DIR006, LAG003, LAG009, LAG011, LAG012, REL001, REL002, REL006, REL007, POS003]

Limitations: several items describe the same traces — the relation items pairing A01 with A03, A04, A06 and A07 largely restate A01's higher participation — so they are not independent confirmations, and the earlier profile of A06's outgoing transitions rests on only about 11 transitions (and A07→A06 afterwards on about 8), leaving the exact rewiring of the A06 branch weakly pinned down. A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is that each window mixes two coexisting variants in different proportions rather than reflecting a single modified process. [DIR005, LAG014, REL001, REL002, REL004, REL005]
